 Diamondbacks To Acquire Johan Oviedo
 By Darragh McDonald |
 at November 20, 2026 5:07pm CDT 
 The Diamondbacks have acquired right-hander Johan Oviedo from the Red Sox, reports Robert Murray of FanSided . The Red Sox will receive minor league left-hander Luke Dotson and a player to be named later, reports Nick Piecoro of the Arizona Republic . Arizona has 40-man space and doesn’t need to make a corresponding move.
 More to come.
